faqs.question: I am not technical.
faqs.answer: Every step is written. Layers 1 to 3 need no code, and the one advanced setup in Layer 4 is optional.

faqs.question: I tried AI tools and got overwhelmed.
faqs.answer: The kit is built for that. It tells you what to do first: one pain, one setup, one week.

faqs.question: What if I get stuck?
faqs.answer: Bring your screen to the weekend live class, or ask in the private community.

faqs.question: Do I need paid tools?
faqs.answer: Some setups do. Each page says what it needs, and free options come first where they exist.

faqs.question: Will it work for my business in Nigeria?
faqs.answer: The examples use naira and bank alerts. A few tools are not available in every country. The setup page tells you when that matters.

faqs.question: What if a tool changes?
faqs.answer: Tools change their menus and free limits often. When that happens, the setup page is updated and the change is logged on the New This Week page. You can also ask in the community.

faqs.question: How do I get the kit?
faqs.answer: After payment, you get a link to the kit and an invite to the community. Open it on your phone or your laptop.

faqs.question: Can I share the kit with someone?
faqs.answer: No. The kit is for the person who bought it. But when you introduce someone to the community and they join us, you get a 30% partner share, forever, with no limit on how many people you bring.
